pages.title: Beatrice's Domain Spells
pages.text: • $(bold)Chessboard Judgement$(reset): Illuminates and detonates alternating 8×8 chunk tiles.$(br)• $(bold)Chessboard Field$(reset): Flips arena black/white tile hazards for 30s.$(br)• $(bold)Golden Rain$(reset): Showers golden butterfly bolts across the chunk.$(br)• $(bold)Witch's Domain$(reset): Shrinking ring forcing players inward; the $(bold)center core ring$(reset) is the sole safe zone at detonation.

pages.title: Divine & Lightning Spells
pages.text: • $(bold)Lightning / Chain / Storm$(reset): Telegraphed strikes, multi-target arcs, and storm canopies.$(br)• $(bold)Gungnir$(reset): 24-block piercing lance corridor.$(br)• $(bold)Mjolnir$(reset): Inner/outer shockwave slam.$(br)• $(bold)Aegis$(reset): Heavily deflects projectile damage.$(br)• $(bold)Soul Chain$(reset): Links nearby mobs to share incoming damage.
